rules.title: Server rules
rules.subtitle: Rules apply to every player
rules.warning: Violations may result in a warning, mute, or ban.
rules.g1: Respect other players. Insults, toxicity, and discrimination are forbidden.
rules.g2: Cheats, hacks, X-Ray, macros, and exploits are forbidden.
rules.g3: Multi-accounts to evade punishment or gain advantage are forbidden.
rules.g4: Advertising other servers without staff permission is forbidden.
rules.gp1: Griefing in protected regions is forbidden.
rules.gp2: Do not claim excessive land — build reasonably.
rules.gp3: AFK farms that overload the server may be removed.
rules.p1: PvP is allowed in designated zones and by mutual consent.
rules.p2: Trapping and excessive harassment of new players is forbidden.
rules.e2: Item dupes and economy exploits result in a ban.
rules.c1: Spam, excessive caps, and flood are forbidden.
rules.c2: Sharing others' personal data without consent is forbidden.
rules.b1: Offensive or inappropriate builds are forbidden.
rules.a1: You are responsible for your account security.
rules.pu1: Punishments: mute, kick, temp-ban, permanent ban depending on severity.
